status: approved by the owner on 2026-10-29, as proposed, before any held-out run
heldOutManifest: Data/PhotoEvaluation/Holdout.v1.json (hash frozen in Data/PhotoEvaluation/Freeze.json before the first run)

rationale.coveredTop1: Same floor as description search (V05Protocol.v2 top1 0.4), on species with a bundled reference photo. An abstention counts as a miss.
rationale.coveredTop10: Same as description top10 0.8: the right species within the ten results shown.
rationale.noMatchCorrect: Same as description noMatchCorrect 1.0: a photo of something outside the catalogue must give 'No confident photo match', never a species. Correct means the photo abstained.
rationale.confidenceCompliant: Same as description confidenceCompliant 1.0: no photo-only result above the limited cap (0.64), so a photo alone never shows more than 'Possible match'.
rationale.uncovered: Species without a reference photo can't be matched; they are reported (abstain rate, what was shown) and must be confidence compliant, but have no accuracy floor.
rationale.groups: Animal groups and underwater versus not are reported, not gated: most groups are too small for a floor, and underwater is unknown for iNaturalist photos.
rationale.samples: A gate with fewer cases than minimumSamples fails as not evaluated; 0/0 is never a pass (as in V05Protocol.v2).

thresholdRule: The abstain threshold is set from the development split only: the smallest normalized similarity at which the development no-match photos meet noMatchCorrect. Never from the held-out set.
rules: Floors are fixed before the first held-out run and are not changed after seeing held-out results without the owner's approval.
Held-out photos are never used as references, for training or for tuning.
Photo identification stays off in Release whatever the results.
